key_concepts: Panel CHOP placed in the Slider component
click(uOrV, v, clickCount, force, left, middle, right, vOnly)
common_gotchas: Slider values are Panel Values; a Panel CHOP placed in the Slider component is the official direct CHOP read path.
Slider UV outputs value0 and value1, so downstream mappings must preserve both axes when the control is two-dimensional.
Zone bounds are normalized panel coordinates and values outside the 0-1 range can be used, so do not model them as a simple rangemin/rangemax pair.
Clamp U/V parameters clamp panel values; still scale or filter slider output with Math CHOP before driving sensitive visual parameters.
A Slider COMP needs a reader or binding path to affect the network; creating the panel alone does not drive parameters.
